why: A COMMENT ASSERTING SINGULARITY IS NOT CHECKABLE BY READING EITHER WRITER (Guy, 21 Aug 2026). Only enumerating them works, and nothing enumerated them. This file is that enumeration: for each column whose stored value is claimed to have one source of truth, the writers that ACTUALLY write it, checked against the source by test/unit/single-writer-columns.test.ts.
how_to_read: declared_writers is what is TRUE. claim names where singularity is ASSERTED and which function it names. claim_holds says whether those two agree. A false claim_holds is legitimate and must carry a reason; what is not legitimate is a writer nobody declared.

columns.claim: migration 0004's COMMENT ON TYPE transaction_direction: 'resolveDirection IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the stored value'
columns.note: ZERO WRITERS IS THE CORRECT STATE AS OF 0035 AND IS NOT A SCAN FAILURE. direction is M5's filing and M5 does not exist, so nothing writes it and every row is NULL. M4 wrote it from 0003 to 0035 using the sign alone, which stored 520 internal vault transfers as income. The fact moved to transactions.flow. When M5 lands, resolveDirection becomes the single declared writer.
columns.reason: NOT YET TRUE, WHICH IS DIFFERENT FROM CONTRADICTED, AND THE DISTINCTION IS THE POINT. Until 0035 the claim was actively false: M4 wrote this column with its own sign rule while 0004 named resolveDirection as the single source. Now NOTHING writes it, so nothing contradicts the claim and nothing satisfies it either. resolveDirection still exists only in categorization-spec section 8 and in migration comments. Set claim_holds true when M5 lands and resolveDirection is the one declared writer. The control refused an attempt to mark it true at 0035, correctly: zero writers means the named source is not the writer.

columns.claim: migration 0035: flow is a fact M4 writes, direction is a filing M5 writes
columns.note: The fact half of what direction used to conflate. One writer, in the pipeline, where it belongs.
